procedure_name: Tree Pruning and Dangerous Branch Removal Permission
summary: Permit required before pruning or cutting overgrown trees touching power lines or endangering private structures.
estimated_total_cost: ₹0 for municipal trees; ₹200 fee for private premises

steps.title: Take location photographs
steps.description: Photograph tree showing dangerous proximity to building wall, roof, or electrical conductors.

steps.title: Submit online request
steps.description: Submit request on municipal citizen portal specifying species (if known) and reason for cutting/pruning.

steps.title: Horticulture inspector site appraisal
steps.description: Horticulture officer visits premises to confirm hazard and issue pruning guidance.

steps.title: Issuance of work permit
steps.description: Municipal department dispatches bucket crane for street trees, or issues written clearance for private courtyard trees.
